# web/dist Placeholders

> **IMPORTANT**: The files in this directory (`index.html`, `manifest.webmanifest`, `manifest.json`, `sw.js`, `favicon.svg`, `assets/*`) are **temporary placeholders** created for Issue #58 to enable and verify Go BFF `embed.FS` packaging, HTTP caching headers, and SPA fallback routing.
>
> When implementing **Issue #61** ("Scaffold React 19 client with Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4 responsive layout"), these files will be overwritten by the output of `pnpm build` (`vite build`).
